'''Nikolai Vasilievich Ardelyan''' ({{langx|ru|Никола́й Васи́льевич Арделя́н}}; born 18 September 1953) is a [[Russian mathematician]], [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]], [[Doctor of Science|Dr.Sc.]], Honored Scientist of the Moscow State University, Leading Researcher of the [[MSU Faculty of Computational Mathematics and Cybernetics]].<ref>Faculty of computational mathematics and Cybernetics: History and modernity: Biographical directory / Author-compiler Evgeny Grigoriev - Moscow, Publishing House of the Moscow State University, 2010. p.149 - 616 p. {{ISBN|978-5-211-05838-5}} {{in lang|ru}}</ref>

He defended the thesis «Difference-Operational Diagrams of the Dynamics of a Magnetic Gas» by the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (1992).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Арделян Николай Васильевич {{!}} ВМК МГУ |url=https://cs.msu.ru/persons/657 |access-date=2024-04-23 |website=cs.msu.ru}}</ref>

Author of 4 books and more than 160 scientific articles.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Арделян Николай Васильевич — профиль {{!}} ИСТИНА |url=https://istina.msu.ru/profile/NikArd/ |access-date=2024-04-23 |website=istina.msu.ru}}</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=30068&option_lang=eng Math-net.ru][http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?&personid=54215&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Sergei Abramov]{{in lang|en}}</ref>

Honored Research Fellow of [[Moscow State University]] (2003).
